basic_info.description: Nestled in the highly sought-after Sherwood Forest neighborhood, this fully detached home offers the perfect blend of timeless design and modern comfort. It features 4 spacious bedrooms and 3 updated bathrooms, with a spacious 2,027 sq ft of living space. The open floor plan includes hardwood floors, a cozy fireplace, and lots of natural light throughout. Upstairs, you'll find 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, perfect for comfortable family living. The kitchen has been beautifully renovated with custom cabinets, high-end stainless steel appliances, a large island for dining or gathering, skylights, and modern LED lighting. Enjoy stunning ocean view and beautiful sunset golden light fills the living room, creating a warm and peaceful feeling. Just minutes from the shops and restaurants at West Portal, and close to the scenic trails of Mt. Davidson Park, this home offers both convenience and a connection to nature.
